appDesc.message: Sort your Instagram saved posts and followed accounts into topics, with a short digest for each.

noBookmarks.message: No digests yet. Open a topic in Saved and press "Make digest".

syncingFollowers.message: Fetching your followers (to find mutual-follow friends)…

friendsNoBack.message: $2 of $1 friends do not follow you back (followers as of $3)

noDigestYet.message: This topic has no digest yet.

mergeHint.message: "$1" already exists. Enter merges the two topics and their digests.

confirmDeleteCat.message: Delete "$1"? Its follows and saved posts ($2) become not sorted, and the AI sorts them again on the next run. This also deletes its digests.

mergingSmall.message: Moving small topics into similar ones ($1)…

rateLimited.message: Gemini is handling a lot of requests. Continuing in $1 seconds…

fellBackQuota.message: $1 is out of quota for today. Continuing with $2…

error.message: Didn't finish ($1). Try again. If it keeps happening, use Report a problem in Settings.

loginFirst.message: Log in to instagram.com in this browser first.

igFailed.message: Could not read Instagram. Reload the instagram.com tab and sync again.

igRefused.message: Instagram turned the request down ($1). Wait a few minutes, then press Sync. Data from earlier syncs is kept.

quotaOutAll.message: Today's free Gemini quota is used up. Finished work is saved. Try again when it resets, or enable billing on the API key.

allBusy.message: Gemini is too busy or unreachable right now. Finished work is saved. Try again in a few minutes.

geminiFailed.message: Gemini returned an error (HTTP $1): $2 Check the API key and model names in Settings, or try again later.

digestEmpty.message: Gemini wrote no digest, possibly blocked by its safety filter. Try a different instruction; the current digest is unchanged.

followingShrank.message: Got only $1 of $2 followed accounts, so the old list was kept. If you really unfollowed them, press Sync once more to accept the new list.

needKey.message: Synced. Add a Gemini API key in Settings to sort into topics.

welcomeTitle.message: Sort your Instagram in three steps

welcomeLead.message: About 5 minutes. Your data stays on this computer.

s1Open.message: Open the key page and sign in with your Google account:

s1Create.message: Click "Create API key". It is free.

s1Paste.message: Copy the key (it starts with AIza) and paste it below.

s1Note.message: The key stays on this computer and is only sent to Google Gemini. The free tier is enough.

keyBad.message: This key does not work. Check that you copied all of it; it starts with AIza.

keyDenied.message: This key cannot use Gemini. Create a new key in AI Studio.

keyBusy.message: Google turned the request down (too many requests or no quota left). Try again in a minute.

keyOffline.message: Cannot reach Google. Check your internet connection and try again.

keyOther.message: Google returned an error (HTTP $1). Try again later.

s2Title.message: Sign in to Instagram, then sync

s2Login.message: Sign in to instagram.com in this Chrome.

s2Sync.message: Press Sync. It only reads your own saved posts and following list. It never posts, likes or changes anything.

s2Time.message: The first sync takes a few minutes. It waits 2–5 seconds between pages to keep your account safe.

s3Busy.message: Sorting now. Progress is in the status bar below. Your topics open when it is done.

clubLine.message: Want to learn more AI tools? Wonder Pocket Club has step-by-step lessons.

noteEditing.message: Merging ideas and editing the note…

noteRest.message: $1 more ideas outside the main line

skipTeaser.message: The idea is in the video or images, not the text

skipOfftopic.message: May be in the wrong topic

noteNoContent.message: The ideas in this topic are in videos or images, so there is not enough text for a note.

noteThin.message: $1 posts had nothing usable and were left out.

refinePlaceholder.message: For example: condense into formulas, like Sales = pain scenario + solution

confirmDeleteDigest.message: Other digests in this topic are kept.

apiKeyHelp.message: Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored only in this browser.

modelHelp.message: It makes many calls, so pick one with a high free quota.

aiLangHelp.message: The language AI uses for topics and digests.

sectionAiHelp.message: Sort and write digests with your own Gemini key.

tidyHelp.message: Merge overlapping topics and write a one-line definition for each.

recategorizeHelp.message: Clear automatic topics and digests, then sort again. Topics you set by hand stay.

sectionSupportHelp.message: Report a problem or learn more.

errorReportHelp.message: Send your recent error log straight to us.

clearDataHelp.message: Delete synced lists, topics and digests. Settings and your key stay.

tidyMergeHint.message: Merge these overlapping topics? Untick any you want to keep apart. Their digests move too.

tidyNoMerge.message: No overlapping topics found. The definitions below steer future sorting.

tidyDone.message: Tidied. Topics merged: $1. Topics with a definition: $2.

tidyEmpty.message: Gemini returned no definitions. Try again.

confirmResort.message: Re-sort everything? This deletes all digests and sorts every item again, except topics you set by hand. It uses many Gemini calls.

confirmClear.message: Delete all synced lists, topics and digests? Topics you set by hand go too, and you can't undo this. Settings and your API key stay.

nextStep.message: Next: you know what you save most. To turn that into a direction, take the Wonder Pocket Club classroom, Lv1 "See yourself in your saves".
